activity.role: Chairman of the Azerbaijani National Council
activity.notes: Rasulzade was elected chairman of the Azerbaijani National Council on 27 May 1918. The Council proclaimed the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic on 28 May. Its activity was suspended from 17 June and resumed on 16 November; Rasulzade remained the Council's chairman and opened the first Parliament on 7 December, when the parliamentary phase replaced the National Council. ATLAS binds the office to the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic as the political community constituted by the Council; the one-day pre-proclamation start reflects the actual office term rather than retroactively changing the polity's independence date.
